Do you enjoy turning complex data into clear choices that help VELUX use resources wisely? As S&OP Specialist, you will work across functions to develop scenarios and recommendations that support senior management in making key planning decisions.

Meet your future team

You will join Global Planning – S&OP & Planning Excellence, a team that collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Regional Management, Supply and Finance to support connected planning processes across VELUX. The team consists of six colleagues based in Skjern and Kolding.

The S&OP Specialist is a new role in the team, introduced to ensure better alignment across functions in the planning processes.

What We Offer

As S&OP Specialist, you will support the Global S&OP process by consolidating market input, preparing scenarios and creating decision material and recommendations for senior management. You will bring structure to S&OP preparation and ensure that agreed decisions are translated into clear planning requirements.

As part of your onboarding, you will be introduced and trained in the current Demand Planning processes and tools to build your understanding of the VELUX supply chain and planning processes.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Ensure that worst/best case sales scenarios is agreed and aligned with the regional management in key markets and understand their assumptions, risk and opportunities.

• Support the global Demand Planning Network in coordinating market input, sales uncertainties, campaigns, allocation requirements and scenarios.

• Plan and facilitate Pre-S&OP meetings and prepare topics that require decisions.

• Develop and evaluate scenarios with Sales, Supply, Purchasing, and Finance, including implications for service, inventory, capacity, production, costs and financial performance.

• Prepare clear decision material for Global S&OP meetings, outlining alternatives, business trade-offs, risks and required decisions.

• Document decisions and follow up on actions, deadlines and outcomes, while translating agreed decisions into input for Master Planning.

This role can be based in Skjern, Kolding, Østbirk or Hørsholm and you can expect minimal traveling in Denmark and abroad.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring experience from a planning-related role and understand how decisions on demand, supply, inventory and financial priorities connect across the value chain and have translated that understanding into measurable business outcomes.

You combine curiosity and structure with a commercial mindset and business acumen; you can challenge assumptions constructively and connect planning decisions to customer needs, operational trade-offs and financial performance.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, Supply Planning, Master Planning, Sales Forecasting or Supply Chain Analysis in fast-moving consumer goods.

• Have extensive understanding of S&OP and end-to-end supply chain planning, including how planning decisions affect service, capacity, inventory and production.

• Have advanced Excel skills, experience using Power BI for analysis and reporting, and familiarity with SAP BW/BWP data structures and data extraction.

• Have the financial understanding needed to assess business cases and quantify the implications of scenarios for costs, inventory, revenue and overall business performance.

• Can establish constructive working relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels to ensure that decisions, assumptions, responsibilities and actions are transparent and followed through.

• Can translate data-based scenarios into simple, clear visualisations that enable decision makers to compare options, understand key trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £75,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Are you ready to help shape the future of hearing care? In this role, you will identify emerging technologies and turn promising opportunities into mature concepts that can inform GN Hearing’s future solutions.

In the role of Incubation & Technology Scouting Lead in the GN Hearing R&D organization, you will connect external technology intelligence with GN Hearing’s internal capabilities to mature early opportunities into validated concepts, prototypes and well-framed development initiatives.

The Team You Will Be Part Of

You will join GN Hearing’s R&D organization, where we develop advanced hearing solutions that support people with hearing loss in everyday life. Our work brings together expertise across audiology, acoustics, electronics, mechanics, embedded software, algorithms, fitting solutions and digital services.

You will work across a broad network of technical specialists, product teams and external partners. We are curious, collaborative and practical in our approach, combining exploration with a clear focus on bringing meaningful innovations closer to product development.

Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

• Scout and assess technology opportunities by monitoring emerging technologies, companies, suppliers, research and ecosystem developments relevant to GN Hearing’s technology and product strategy.

• Build actionable technology intelligence by maintaining the opportunity roadmap, knowledge base and internal expert network, and translating internal and external signals into recommendations for R&D leadership, product management and innovation teams.

• Evaluate and mature external opportunities through early technical dialogue, partner assessments and due diligence, with appropriate consideration for confidentiality, intellectual property, data and regulatory requirements.

• Turn opportunities into development-ready concepts by leading feasibility work, proof of concepts and early prototypes, and aligning cross-functional experts around system vision, interfaces, performance targets, risks and key assumptions.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

• You bring an advanced degree in a related technical field.

• You may have experience in advanced R&D, hearing technology, medical-device development, systems engineering, innovation or technical product incubation.

• You bring deep technical knowledge into one or more relevant domains, such as acoustics, audiological algorithms, low-power electronics, embedded systems, connectivity, sensors, mechanical design, fitting systems, mobile software or AI and machine learning.

• You have experience moving early technology or product ideas from exploration through concept definition and proof of concept towards product development, including complex systems spanning devices, software and digital services.

• You communicate clearly, make sound recommendations with incomplete information and work well with technical and business stakeholders across the organization.

We pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you do not match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 30. Applications are assessed continuously, so do not wait to send yours.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement **here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

- for the developer who wants to build real things with AI

You write clean code, you have started integrating LLMs into real projects, and you are curious about what comes next. In Egmont's Data & AI Solutions team, you will build practical AI solutions - APIs, LLM wrappers, MCP connectors - that business teams across the Nordics depend on, while sharing ownership of the production systems that keep everything running. Hands-on from day one, with room to grow.

The role

You will be joining a team that builds and maintains AI and data solutions for business units across the Egmont Group - tools and integrations that people actually use.

Your work will cover three areas:

Build applied AI solutions. On top of Egmont’s AI platform infrastructure, you will build LLM wrappers, APIs, and MCP connectors - and take prototypes from concept to working solutions for business units with AI-related challenges.

Support Egmont's companies. You will work directly with companies across the Egmont Group, as both a hands-on builder and an advisor. That means helping business teams see where AI can make a real difference, shaping the right approach with them, and staying involved until it works in practice.

Keep things running - and make them better. You will share ownership of our Prefect-orchestrated Python pipelines alongside our senior engineers, handling operational triage, debugging, and continuous stability improvements.

What you bring

We care more about what you have built and how you think than about your job titles. That said, to hit the ground running, you will bring at least two years of experience in software development or a similar field, along with most of the following:

- Solid Python development experience - clean, modular code and confidence building and consuming APIs, including authentication, JSON and error handling

- Practical LLM integration experience - you have worked with language models in real settings and know your way around context engineering, MCP and agentic integrations

- An analytical and operational mindset - you keep the bigger picture in view, spot problems before they become incidents and take pride in systems that stay stable

Bonus points for experience with orchestration tools, lightweight frontends or Azure and AWS basics.

Beyond the technical, we are looking for someone curious and clear in their communication, who enjoys making technology accessible to non-technical colleagues. Knowledge of a Scandinavian language is an advantage, as Egmont is primarily a Nordic media group.

The team

You will be joining Data & AI Solutions - a tight-knit team of developers. We work closely with the platform team that runs the data and AI infrastructure our solutions are built on, so you will always have strong technical peers to spar with.

The role is based at Egmont's corporate office in Copenhagen. A flexible hybrid setup is possible, and we can agree on the balance between office and home days together.

And yes - the canteen is excellent.

Logistics & How to Apply

- Location: Copenhagen (hybrid possible)

- Application deadline: December 6, 2026

- Employment type: Full-time, permanent

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email. Applications are welcome in Danish, Norwegian, Swedish or English.

We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to reach out to Hampus Vitestam, Manager Data & AI Solutions at hampus.vitestam@egmont.com.

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to drive complex projects in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization. You will translate project strategies into integrated plans and coordinate delivery across internal teams and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Working within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain to advance late-stage programs towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of project delivery, influence cross-functional decisions and strengthen project management practices through mentoring and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities

**CMC project planning and delivery

• Develop and execute integrated project plans, timelines and milestones aligned with the Drug Development Plan. Provide input to optimize project strategy and translate agreed priorities into clear deliverables

• Coordinate internal and external activities, including technology transfer, process validation and manufacturing readiness, managing cross-functional dependencies and ensuring clear ownership and timely delivery

• Lead proactive risk management, prioritizing risks and driving mitigation, escalation and resolution. Maintain current plans, dashboards, action and decision logs, and communicate progress and emerging issues

Supplier coordination and regulatory readiness

• Create and oversee statements of work with relevant functions. Manage project budgets and forecasts, track invoices and proactively address variances against agreed scope, costs and timelines

• Coordinate CDMO and other external partner activities, follow up on deliverables and gather stakeholder input on vendor performance. Build effective relationships and resolve issues collaboratively

• Conduct line-of-business reviews of regulatory documentation supporting global submissions. Ensure technical compliance and timely delivery of source documentation in collaboration with subject matter experts and Regulatory Affairs

• Ensure adherence to Genmab’s quality system requirements. Understand the technical implications of supplier quality agreements, flag risks and coordinate follow-up with Quality and relevant functions

Project governance and ways of working

• Represent project management in internal and external forums. Communicate priorities, risks and recommendations, align stakeholders on decisions and ensure agreed actions are documented and followed through

• Use lessons learned to recommend and implement improvements to project management processes, systems and tools, strengthening consistency and operational effectiveness across the organization

• Train, mentor and guide colleagues in project management practices. Share experience and support effective project execution through informal leadership and constructive feedback

**Requirements

**

• 
Master’s degree in science, engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or relevant certification is an advantage

• 
At least six years of experience in Tech Ops or a related field within a relevant industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• 
Demonstrated success managing complex projects in a cross-functional environment, preferably within late-stage biologics development, with strong planning, budget and risk management skills

• 
Proven ability to influence and coordinate multicultural teams and internal and external stakeholders without direct authority

• 
Solid experience managing CDMOs and contract research organizations, with a strong understanding of intellectual property implications

• 
Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, GMP and regulatory documentation requirements, and their application to CMC project delivery.

• 
Experience implementing process or system improvements, with strong proficiency in project management systems, dashboards and reporting tools.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex topics and recommendations clearly

The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK644.640,00---966.960,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Financial Controller to join our office in Copenhagen.

__CIP Fund Solutions is a platform delivery company working for Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) and funds managed by CIP in providing complex fund management and investment services.

_**Team

**You will join a dynamic and collaborative finance team working across +250 investment vehicles in varying legal structures in 20 EMEA countries. The team consists of 10 skilled financial controllers based in London, Sheffield, Madrid, and Copenhagen, creating a diverse and international working environment. The role is based in our Copenhagen office.

We are responsible for financial reporting, accounting, and compliance for a broad portfolio of companies, and we collaborate closely with the investment teams and external advisors across the region. The team values accuracy, ownership, and clear communication, while maintaining a supportive and informal culture where collaboration and continuous learning is key.

**Role

**Reporting into the EMEA Vice President of accounting, Controlling and Compliance, you will develop and maintain our finance setup for the investment vehicles, while having oversight and controlling of the day-to-day accounting performed by third-party service providers. In so doing, you will be responsible for establishing, implementing and delivering best-in-class finance processes.

**Responsibilities will further include:

**

• Controlling accounts including balance sheet reconciliations, IC loans, dual bookkeeping systems reconciliation, etc.

• Oversight of the P2P process performed by third-party service providers, ensuring timely approval of invoices and payments including aligning cash calls

• Ensuring timely submission and payment of tax filings including VAT, CIT, WHT etc.

• Overseeing and improving external service provider quality

• Overseeing the setting up of new investment structures

• Support mergers and acquisitions

**You

**You have an MSc in Economics or Finance and minimum 3 years of full-time experience in audit, financial controlling, or consultancy from a Big4 firm. You are motivated by building best practices, improving finance deliverables and improving CIP fund returns through effective operational finance execution.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Comprehensive knowledge of accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written

• Knowledge of corporate finance

• Experience with Business Central is an advantage

• German language is in advantage

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

Do you feel personally responsible when players rage quit over a bad connection? Do you enjoy creating the tech that prevents it? Great! Help us.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We’re building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy and built to be played together online. We’re now looking for a Senior Game Programmer (Multiplayer) to implement the tech that makes it all work. This new project is living in a different world from our WHAT THE? games, built by a growing team with a playbook of its own.

**Here’s What You’ll Do Day To Day

**

• Build and iterate on smooth, low-latency online play on top of an existing game tech infrastructure, in close collaboration with designers, artists, and other programmers

• Work hands-on in Unity using the multiplayer framework Coherence

• Focus on multiplayer as your technical domain, working within the patterns and architecture already in place, and doing it in a way that keeps the codebase easy for others to build on

• Contribute to end-to-end user-facing feature development

• Share knowledge and raise the multiplayer bar across the studio over time

**Must-haves

**

• You’ve worked on at least one online multiplayer game (ideally shipped)

• You have a strong understanding of multiplayer networking concepts (e.g. peer-to-peer, client/host models, synchronisation, lag compensation), and you can explain them clearly to non-experts

• You understand the tradeoffs between peer-to-peer and server-authoritative approaches (bandwidth, latency, security, scalability), and can choose the right model for the problem

• You enjoy mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and helping others level up

• You’re willing to work on macOS and get comfortable with Apple-related constraints/tech because you’ll be working in the Apple ecosystem

• You're experimenting with ways to use AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) in your day-to-day

**Nice-to-haves

**

• Experience with multiplayer game design

• Experience working on complex projects in a team of 20-30 people

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**This project is something new, but our ways of working are the same. We’ve always believed that games are made by teams, not solo rockstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. What we also believe in:

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them.

• You’re up for experimentation, and at the same time you don’t get too precious when the experience tells you you’re wrong.

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place.

**Practicalities

**

• We don't offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• We work a 37-hour work week with flexible hours.

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of coffee.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 65 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

We're looking for a Head of IT who wants to build something most companies are still only talking about: AI-native IT operations. You'll own our IT function end-to-end, with the mandate, the tools, and the backing to automate as much as you can. If automating IT operations excites you, and you want room to see how far it can go, this is for you.

What you'll build

Most IT functions run on people working through admin consoles and ticket queues. We want ours to run on systems: agents, pipelines and automations that do the work, with you as their architect. Often that means connecting systems yourself: using AI to integrate one tool with another, in a way that's secure and keeps personal data where it belongs.

A few pictures of where this could lead. Which become real, and how, is your call:

- Your team is the agents you build. They handle onboarding, access, devices and support. You decide what they do alone, what needs a human, and how that changes as they earn trust.

- IT you just ask. "Maria starts Monday as a data analyst" becomes an identity, licences, groups, an enrolled laptop and Slack access. Within policy, fully logged, and nobody opened an admin console.

- No standing access for people or agents. Access is granted when it's needed, justified, logged and removed automatically. Least privilege maintains itself instead of waiting for a quarterly review.

- Every agent is governed like a colleague. AI is spreading across every team here. Each agent, in engineering and beyond, gets an identity, a scope and a lifecycle, managed as rigorously as people.

What makes this hard is also what makes it worth doing. Our users trust us with their tax and financial data, and that trust is the business. So security and privacy aren't a layer on top of this work; they're the design brief.

An agent with admin rights is a new attack surface, so its permissions must be scoped, time-bound, auditable and visible to our 24/7 security monitoring. AI must never become a path for personal data to leave our control: what a model sees, where it runs and what it retains are decisions you make and defend. And when an agent is unsure, it stops and asks a human.

We plan to grow from 65 to 100+ people over the next few years, and IT has to keep pace. Automation has helped IT scale for years, but AI changes how much of the work it can take on. That combination, not hiring, is the main lever we want to use.

What you'll own

You'll own IT end-to-end:

- Identity and access: provisioning, access rights, least privilege and licence management

- Endpoints: a fleet of mostly MacBooks, with some Windows, managed via MDM.

- Hardware: laptops, screens, peripherals and meeting-room equipment, from buying and setting up workstations for new joiners to fixing what breaks

- Network: firewall, switches and access points

- Security controls: turning security requirements into practical configurations, and supporting our compliance work

- Day-to-day operations: onboarding, offboarding, Microsoft 365, Slack and hands-on support. When a laptop won't charge, or a VPN acts up, you're the person people turn to.

- Documentation and vendors: so things don't live only in your head, and so agents have the context they need

Beyond IT itself, every team here uses AI, and agents need identities, scoped access, managed devices and the right knowledge to work with. You'll work closely with our DevOps platform team on how engineers work with agents. You'll also help define how AI is set up across the company, including how agents get the context they need without seeing more than the person they act for.

How you'll work

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll make the plans, set the priorities, weigh the trade-offs, and then do the work.

The big platform choices are made at company level. We're Microsoft-centred: hosting is moving to Azure, and Entra ID is our identity provider. One stack gives us one identity plane and one automation surface, all visible to our security monitoring. If you have good arguments for doing something differently, we want to hear them. Everything below that is yours: the tools, the vendors, the priorities and how it's built.

You'll report to our CTO. He won't manage IT; you will, and he's your sparring partner on direction. You'll own the IT budget, and decisions here are fast: if a tool will help, a lean procurement process gets it in place without committees.

You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Privacy, Legal Counsel, Engineering and the rest of the business, with no one brokering it for you.

Where you'll start

You'll take ownership of a recently insourced IT function, with the opportunity to shape its foundations. You'll assess what's there and decide what to keep, change or improve, so the foundations everything else builds on are yours.

From there, the arc is roughly this:

1. Solid foundations: make the setup yours, and strong enough to build on.

2. Automate the everyday: support, onboarding and access are the first and most obvious targets.

3. Scale: agents across the company, and IT that keeps up with growth by building first.

Who we're looking for

We're open to the exact background. What matters most is how you work: you think AI-first, you have a solid IT foundation, and you use AI to go deep on whatever comes next, with the judgment to know when its answers are right.

Must-have

- You think AI-first. You use AI in your daily work and reach for it first. You've built automations or integrations with AI, ideally ones that use AI themselves, and you can show us examples.

- You learn with AI, and judge what it gives you. When you meet a technology you don't know, you use AI to get up to speed, and you know enough to tell when its suggestion is right, wrong or risky.

- Automation excites you. You see a repeated task as something to automate, and you enjoy finding out how far automation and AI can take IT.

jobs.occupation: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). The position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter for a 3-year period – with the possibility of extension. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Documented education as engineer or technician

• 
Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

• 
Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

• 
Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

• 
Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.
